use_case: Demand forecasting by product family for capacity planning, material purchasing, and storm-restoration slot proposals at both plants
vendor_or_model: Company-built time-series model on the cloud ML service (ERP production account extract)
data_categories: ERP order history by customer segment; backlog; public hurricane-season outlooks; includes FCI (federal delivery schedules); no personal data
consequential_decision_category: None (business planning; affects utility customers' production slots, not individuals)
human_in_the_loop: Production Planning Manager approves every monthly plan; minimum storm-slot rule per customer segment overrides the forecast
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 (FCI stays in the company's cloud account); no sector or state AI rule identified; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-006)

use_case: Predictive maintenance alerts for 2 drying ovens and 8 winding machines at Plant 1 from historian data
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance vendor SaaS (vendor model trained on company and fleet data), fed from the read-only historian replica in the Plant 1 OT DMZ
data_categories: About 220 historian process tags (temperatures, pressures, currents, vibration); operator ID tags excluded; no personal data
consequential_decision_category: None today; re-tier to High (Safety/CI) if used to extend or skip preventive maintenance on ovens, vacuum, or oil processing
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance Manager decides every action; preventive maintenance schedule unchanged; outbound-only read connector
applicable_laws: No sector or state AI rule identified; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); SP 800-82 Rev. 3 benchmark for the OT DMZ connection (P03 G-071)
status: Pilot at Plant 1 (since 2026-04); continue with conditions; not at Plant 2 until its OT DMZ exists

use_case: FMS transformer condition analytics: classifies dissolved gas, temperature, and load patterns into fault types and urgency for about 1,150 utility power transformers
vendor_or_model: Company-built model (gradient-boosted classifier plus rule-based gas ratio checks) in the FMS production account
data_categories: TMU data pushed by 14 utilities; company factory test and teardown records 2015-2025; no personal data
affects_individuals: No (affects utility assets and grid operations, not individuals)
human_in_the_loop: Reliability engineer reviews every Urgent alert within 4 hours before release; Watch advisories auto-published with confidence labels; utilities make all operating decisions
applicable_laws: FMS subscription agreements; FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy claims in marketing); utility addenda where the FMS is a supplied service; no sector AI rule identified

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for engineering, sales proposals, and internal documents (pilot, 120 users)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service in the company's productivity tenant (vendor contract prohibits training on company data)
data_categories: Internal and Confidential documents; Restricted designs and FCI allowed only inside the company tenant
human_in_the_loop: A qualified person reviews any output used in a design, quote, customer document, or decision about a person (POL-05 4.8)

status: Pilot (since 2026-03); expansion to 300 users approved with conditions
